:::{#exr-column-space-practice}
#### Testing whether a vector is in a column space

A vector $\vecf{b}$ is in the [column space](#def-column-space) of a [matrix](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-matrix) $\matr{A}$
exactly when some $\vecf{x}$ gives $\matr{A}\vecf{x} = \vecf{b}$.
Let

$$
\matr{A} = \sbmat{1 & 2 \\ 3 & 6},
\qquad
\vecf{b} = \sbmat{2 \\ 6}.
$$

Decide whether $\vecf{b}$ is in $\mathcal{C}(\matr{A})$.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Try $\vecf{x} = (x_1, 0)$ and solve for $x_1$.

:::
